name: agentlayer
description: AgentLayer's plugin marketplace for Claude Code and Codex. Agentic primitives, identity-aware assistants, and industry-tuned skill packs for fintech, government, healthcare, legal, education, and hospitality. Each plugin ships with built-in human oversight, audit trails, and ASEAN-regional compliance awareness, the foundations of an AI-native operation. agentlayer.one

plugins.name: agent-kevin
plugins.description: Portable, file-based personal AI assistant. Compiles raw sessions into a queryable wiki, manages tasks across project lifecycles, drives SEO/web tools (Google Search Console, PageSpeed, SerpAPI, OpenPageRank, Playwright, Perplexity), and ships 18 skills covering onboarding, daily/weekly/monthly cadences, SEO audits, and content workflows. Runs entirely on local markdown + YAML. Your data lives wherever you launch Claude Code.

plugins.name: agentlayer
plugins.description: An agent that remembers your work, in a folder you own. It captures every session, compiles what it learned into plain markdown, and loads it back before you type. Tasks, briefings, a dashboard, and packs for GitHub, databases, support desks, SEO and a browser. All data stays local. Moving from agent-kevin? Run /agent-kevin:move first.
